standard_challenges.title: Mode of Transit
standard_challenges.description: Use different forms of Milan public transport at stops or stations physically inside the active NIL. A transit mode counts when the team boards or gets off that mode at a stop/station within the NIL.
standard_challenges.proof: A single stop within an NIL may only be used once per transit mode. For Metro or rail, the station exit used must be inside the NIL.

standard_challenges.title: Enjoy a Park
standard_challenges.description: Spend continuous time relaxing, playing, walking, sitting, or otherwise enjoying a park or garden in the active NIL. The place must be labelled or categorised as a park or garden on Google Maps.
standard_challenges.proof: Send a photo of the team in the park at the start and end of the timed period.

standard_challenges.title: Continental Cuisine
standard_challenges.description: Find restaurants, cafés, pubs, takeaways, or food venues in the active NIL representing cuisines from different continent groups. Google Maps must clearly label the cuisine or country/region.

levels.label: Level 2
levels.requirement: Find cuisines from 2 different continent groups.

levels.label: Level 3
levels.requirement: Find cuisines from 3 different continent groups.

levels.label: Level 4
levels.requirement: Find cuisines from 4 different continent groups.

levels.label: Extreme
levels.requirement: Find cuisines from all 5 continent groups.

standard_challenges.proof: Use a different venue for each continent and send a photo of each venue showing its name/front. A venue serving several cuisines counts for only one continent.

standard_challenges.title: Piazza
standard_challenges.description: Find distinct piazze or piazzette in the active NIL named after a real person most famous as a religious figure, politician/activist, artist, scientist/engineer, or military leader. The place must be labelled Piazza or Piazzetta on Google Maps.
standard_challenges.proof: Send a photo of the team at each qualifying piazza/piazzetta showing the place or sign/name where practical.

standard_challenges.title: Fiat Finder
standard_challenges.description: Find parked Fiat Pandas in the active NIL in different qualifying colour groups.
standard_challenges.proof: Send a photo clearly showing each parked Panda and its colour. Do not photograph number plates more closely than necessary.

standard_challenges.title: Old Time Religion
standard_challenges.description: Find a church in the active NIL listed under the required century, or an earlier century, in Wikipedia's 'Chiese di Milano' list under 'Elenco chiese'.
standard_challenges.proof: Send a photo of the team at the church. 'secolo' means century; Roman numerals are used. The church must be inside the active NIL and appear in the qualifying century section of the list.

standard_challenges.title: Milano Scavenger Hunt
standard_challenges.description: Find different categories of Milan-specific items within the active NIL. Each category counts only once and one physical object cannot satisfy two categories.
items: The Comune di Milano coat of arms or logo
An ATM tram, bus or trolleybus stop sign
A public statue, monument or sculpture
A mural or piece of street art
Somewhere visibly selling or advertising panettone
standard_challenges.proof: Send photographs showing each qualifying item and enough context to establish it was found within the active NIL.

standard_challenges.title: Milanese Derby
standard_challenges.description: Before starting, choose AC Milan or Inter Milan. Find visible items supporting or identifying the chosen club at different locations within the active NIL. The same shop/building/location counts only once.
standard_challenges.proof: Official club stores, the San Siro stadium/club museum complex, and repeated items inside one dedicated football-merchandise shop do not count. Send a photo of each qualifying item/location.

special_challenges.title: Walking Tour
special_challenges.description: A qualifying street is a continuous named street within the active NIL. Walk the complete portion of the named street lying inside the NIL; ordinary intersections do not end it if the name continues.

special_challenges.title: Have Lunch
special_challenges.description: Spend at least 45 continuous minutes enjoying a proper lunch in the active NIL.
